name: metaso-search-neo
description: MetaSo search, Reader, cited answers, bounded deep research, and topic knowledge-base tools for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Search, read, verify, and research with MetaSo.
interface.longDescription: MetaSo Search Neo directly integrates MetaSo's public and Open APIs for six-scope search, webpage extraction, cited answers, multi-round deep research, topic knowledge bases, file ingestion, and bookshelf imports. Includes a plugin-global Research Frontier mode with bounded higher-depth defaults.
defaultPrompt: 用 MetaSo 搜索并核实这个问题，保留来源链接。
对这个主题做一份标准深度研究报告。
把这些文件上传到 MetaSo 专题并建立可检索知识库。
